validation.accelerator: 20 passed on H200 with the cached checkpoint

measurement_notes: Final ABBA legs use one GPU and two measured repeats per concurrency after discarded full warmup.

The unmodified compiled control is one later fresh-server leg on the same source base, using the original bound RadixAttention.forward in each draft layer. It has one concurrency repeat; its preceding 120-clip diarization run warms the server.
No profiler is active in the final measured runs. The boundary-2 launcher imports the profiler entrypoint but its instrumentation is explicitly disabled for final legs.
No-draft has one 120-clip diarization pass, compilation enabled.
CER and DER use 116 samples; four clips have no reference segments. The SeedTTS-style client has seven unscorable references per 160 requests.
These are short workloads on one H200; H100, Qwen3-ASR performance, high concurrency beyond 16, long-audio pressure and stochastic sampling are not measured.
